items.information:
Bem-vindos ao Morro Reuter Cubing 2025!

🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorroReuterCubing2023/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HbeQK2gn7Jo&ab_channel=CUBIFMA).

Competidores participando pela primeira vez são obrigados a apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.

Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral).

--

🇺🇸 Welcome to the first competition in Morro Reuter!

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorroReuterCubing2023/register). If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&ab_channel=SamuelBaird).

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will consider the final ranking).

items.name: Cubing Express Buenavista 2025

venue.name: [CEN del PRI] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/PRxeKopX66Yha7Wj6)
venue.address: Av. Insurgentes Nte. 59, Buenavista, Cuauhtémoc, 06350 Ciudad de México, CDMX

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MzYyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0266135e5081fb6c7c2e4bbc209d6826f5bea87/CEB%20logo.jpeg)
***Español***
**¡Hola Cubers! 
Somos Cubers te invita y te da la bienvenida al Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!**
La siguiente comptetencia oficial de speedcubing celebrada en el Auditorio "Plutarco Elías Calles" en el CEN del PRI ubicado en la colonia Buenavista, lugar de la antigua estación de ferrocarriles que conectaba con la mayoría de las rutas de Ferrocarriles Nacionales de México hasta 1997. 
Ven y desafía tus límites, pon a prueba tus habilidades, conoce muchas más personas con la misma pasión por el cubo, disfruta de las dinámicas que tenemos preparadas para ti y sobre todo prepárate para resolver tus puzzles de la manera más Express. 
Te esperamos en el Acceso 1 del CEN del PRI este 16 y 17 de agosto.
¡TODOS A BORDO DEL CUBING EXPRESS!
 
*Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)*
 
 
 ***English***
**Hello Cubers!
Somos Cubers invites you and welcomes you to Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!**
The next WCA speedcubing competition will be held in the "Plutarco Elías Calles" Auditorium at the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) located in the Buenavista neighborhood, the site of the old train station that served most of the Mexican National Railways (FERROCARRILES NACIONALES DE MÉXICO) routes until 1997.
Come and challenge your limits, test your skills, meet many more people with the same passion for cubing, enjoy the dynamics we have prepared for you, and above all, get ready to solve your puzzles in the most Express way possible.
We'll see you at Access 1 of the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) this August 16th and 17th.
ALL ABOARD THE CUBING EXPRESS!

*This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)*
